page.content:
Siege number that ends the war act with Lafayette and Hamilton.

How Yorktown (The World Turned Upside Down) connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Yorktown closes the Revolution half of Hamilton.
  • Character: Marquis de Lafayette — Lafayette takes the Yorktown redoubt beside Hamilton.

What is Yorktown (The World Turned Upside Down)?

Yorktown is the battle song that closes the Revolution half of Hamilton: Lafayette and Hamilton take the redoubt, Cornwallis surrenders, and King George returns to ask what comes next.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical) and Marquis de Lafayette.
